metadata.description: Small quality-of-life mods for Claude Code

plugins.name: folder-title
plugins.description: Prefixes every session title with its project folder: "<folder> - <title>"

plugins.name: reload-inventory
plugins.description: Lists plugins and skills with versions after /reload-plugins and /reload-skills

plugins.name: remote-relay
plugins.description: Over Remote Control, posts other mods' toasts, notifications, status changes and dialogs as notices every device shows

plugins.name: session-launcher
plugins.description: /fs [folder] starts a fresh Remote Control session in auto mode, in this folder or another, from any device

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands and shows what they would change; Proceed or Cancel on any device, Remote Control included (fork of Anthropic's Blast Radius)

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: A context window forecast above the prompt, posted as a notice over Remote Control after every reply (fork of Anthropic's Token Weather)

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Keeps the prompt cache warm during breaks and stops a cold send once with its price; posted as notices over Remote Control (fork of Karan Bansal's Cache Tax)
